## Change

Describe the addition, correction, or removal.

## Evidence and usefulness

Link primary documentation. Explain the personal-agent use case, verification date, limitations, pricing, deployment, availability, and any affiliation. For open-source entries, include the canonical repository, license, and current star count.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The entry is in scope and not duplicated.
- [ ] An open-source entry has at least 1,000 GitHub stars and a verified license, or this change is not an open-source addition.
- [ ] I checked primary documentation and maintenance status.
- [ ] Current features, roadmap items, human assistance, and preview restrictions are distinguished.
- [ ] Formatting and alphabetical ordering are correct.
- [ ] I updated the matching selection-guide content.
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint` or explained why I could not.
